product_one_liner.value: Ordway automates subscription and usage-based billing, payment collection, revenue recognition, and SaaS reporting for finance and revenue operations teams at recurring-revenue businesses.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes the platform's billing, payments, revenue-recognition, and reporting functions, and explicitly identifies finance and revenue operations teams as users: https://ordwaylabs.com/ai-llm.

pricing_page.notes: The inspected homepage navigation and footer provide demo/contact routes rather than a public pricing link or plan page; the tested /pricing/ URL returned no page. This supports false under the requested negative-evidence rule: https://ordwaylabs.com/.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Merge is explicitly described as selecting Ordway in its case study, and Ocrolus appears in the customer logo area. Sources: https://ordwaylabs.com/resources/case-studies/technology/merge-billing-case-study and https://ordwaylabs.com/customers. | named_customers.0: The case study explicitly states that Merge selected Ordway for its order-to-cash process: https://ordwaylabs.com/resources/case-studies/technology/merge-billing-case-study. | named_customers.1: Ocrolus appears as a logo on Ordway's customer page. The identification comes from the logo asset rather than a narrative case-study statement: https://ordwaylabs.com/customers.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 64 employees, which falls within 51-100. This is a profile snapshot rather than an audited headcount: https://linkedin.com/company/ordway.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Ordway explicitly labels its Washington, DC address as headquarters: https://ordwaylabs.com/ai-llm. | hq_country: The headquarters address is Washington, DC, which places it in the United States; the country is normalized from that address: https://ordwaylabs.com/ai-llm.

founded_year.notes: Ordway's company summary explicitly gives 2018 as its founding year: https://ordwaylabs.com/ai-llm.

eng_blog.notes: The inspected blog indexes show business, billing, implementation, and SaaS-metrics content rather than an engineering publication with two engineer-authored product-build posts. Research found only a lone older engineering-related post, so the specified two-post threshold was not met. Sources: https://ordwaylabs.com/resources/blog/ and https://ordwaylabs.com/resources/blog/page/12.

public_docs.notes: The public support portal contains multiple documentation categories and linked product articles, including Matrix Pricing, Prepayment Wallet of Units, and Payment Automation Options: https://support.ordwaylabs.com/hc/en-us.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current openings index lists Product Manager – AI Finance, and its posting has an Apply Now link. It qualifies under the question's explicit AI-in-title rule, although it is a product-management rather than research-scientist role. Sources: https://ordwaylabs.com/careers and https://ordwaylabs.com/careers/product-manager-ai-finance.

model_provider.notes: The integrations page explicitly advertises connecting Anthropic's Claude chatbot to Ordway for natural-language questions and workflow actions. This establishes an advertised Claude integration, not the undisclosed underlying model for every native AI feature: https://ordwaylabs.com/products/integrations.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Ordway explicitly states that it is SOC 2 audited. SOC 1 is also mentioned but is outside the requested list: https://ordwaylabs.com/ai-llm. | compliance_certs.0: Ordway explicitly claims a completed SOC 2 audit, not merely an audit in progress: https://ordwaylabs.com/ai-llm.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profile labels the August 2026 round Series B. Ordway's announcement describes it as growth capital comprising equity and debt, without itself using the Series B label. Sources: https://tracxn.com and https://ordwaylabs.com/press-releases/ordway-secures-growth-capital. | funding_date: The latest-round profile and primary announcement both date the financing to August 5, 2026, normalized to 2026-08: https://ordwaylabs.com/press-releases/ordway-secures-growth-capital. | funding_amount_usd: The announcement states that Ordway secured access to $20 million in additional equity and debt funding; the funding profile identifies the same amount as the latest round. This is the combined financing package, not equity alone: https://ordwaylabs.com/press-releases/ordway-secures-growth-capital.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 5, 2026 announcement reports access to $20 million in additional equity and debt financing, within the requested eighteen-month window: https://ordwaylabs.com/press-releases/ordway-secures-growth-capital.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Account Executive posting has an active application link and is also advertised on the current careers index. Sources: https://ordwaylabs.com/careers/account-executive and https://ordwaylabs.com/careers.

launched_6mo.notes: Ordway launched AI-powered Ordway Payments on July 22, 2026. The product unifies billing and payments in an integrated application, constituting a major launch within the six-month window: https://ordwaylabs.com/press-releases/ordway-launches-ai-powered-payments.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The April 1, 2026 announcement states that Mike Miele joined Ordway as Vice President of Sales, within the requested twelve-month window: https://ordwaylabs.com/press-releases/mike-miele-vice-president-sales/.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Ordway's integration documentation names Salesforce and HubSpot under CRM and sales. These are visible integration signals, not proof of its internal sales team's deployment: https://ordwaylabs.com/ai-llm. | crm_stack_signal.0: Salesforce is explicitly named in Ordway's CRM and sales integrations: https://ordwaylabs.com/ai-llm. | crm_stack_signal.1: HubSpot is explicitly named, with configurable field mapping, App Cards, and an in-CRM Plan Picker: https://ordwaylabs.com/ai-llm.
